ownership_corrections.reason: MSC _DATA SEGDEFs are WORD aligned, so the object's _DATA cannot start at odd 180605 (real LINK run: +1 cascade through DGROUP). The preceding 27 bytes 'crak','cinf','scensce2sce3sce4' are string literals of this object's own init_crak/load_skybox (formerly externs), so _DATA starts at even 180578; the old 57-byte RESOURCE_NAMES struct is replaced by the literals of load_sdgame2_shapes/setup_intro plus the word-aligned global aCarcoun_0 (its alignment hole is the zero byte at 180653).

seg008 loads nopsub_36AF2 as the relocated far pointer 26AF:0002 (MOV AX,2 / MOV DX,26AFh at 102605, relocation 102609): its segment is framed 0x26AF, not seg017's 0x268A. [158450,158452) is therefore not part of this seg017 object, which ends at 158450 after nopsub_36ACA; a real LINK run otherwise produces 268A:0252.

MSC _DATA SEGDEFs are WORD aligned, so the object's _DATA cannot start at odd 199447. The preceding 5 bytes 'pc15' are the writable driver-name array that init_main of this object patches (audiodriverstring[0..1]); it is defined here (char audiodriverstring[] = "pc15"), so _DATA starts at even 199442 at its reviewed alias address.
